oa-capital-one-19.title: Sum Digits Until One
oa-capital-one-19.fixedSourceEvidence: The immutable MDX defines repeatedly summing decimal digits to one digit, then taking the mode. Its sample confirms 1234→1, 24→6, 33→6, answer 6. The accompanying explanation and solution choose the largest root on frequency ties; this convention is disclosed by this site package because the statement itself does not specify ties.
oa-capital-one-19.siteAddedContract: Non-negative decimal digit strings only; leading zeroes are allowed and have the same value under the source's numeric conversion. Negative signs are excluded because the source discusses positive integers and digit sums, not signed notation. Largest tied mode follows the supplied explanation/implementation but is explicitly labeled as a site rule. Standard stdin/stdout and finite limits are site additions.
